name: Mendelian Randomization
overview: 利用遗传变异作为工具变量评估暴露与结局的因果关系。支持双样本 MR（使用 GWAS summary statistics），覆盖 IV 选择、harmonization、多方法 MR 估计和敏感性分析。
overviewEn: Uses genetic variants as instrumental variables to assess causal relationships between exposures and outcomes. Supports two-sample MR (using GWAS summary statistics), covering IV selection, harmonization, multi-method MR estimation, and sensitivity analysis.

steps.name: 选择工具变量
steps.description: 从暴露 GWAS 选 IV（P < 5e-8），Clumping（r² < 0.001, 10Mb），检查 F-statistic > 10
steps.descriptionEn: Select IVs from exposure GWAS (P < 5e-8), clumping (r² < 0.001, 10Mb), check F-statistic > 10

steps.name: 提取结局 SNP + Harmonization
steps.description: 提取结局 GWAS 对应 SNP，正链对齐，去除回文 SNP（MAF > 0.4）
steps.descriptionEn: Extract corresponding SNPs from outcome GWAS, align to forward strand, remove palindromic SNPs (MAF > 0.4)

steps.name: MR 估计
steps.description: IVW（主方法）、MR-Egger、加权中位数、加权模式、最多似然法
steps.descriptionEn: IVW (primary), MR-Egger, weighted median, weighted mode, maximum likelihood

tools.name: TwoSampleMR mr()
tools.notes: IVW 为主方法。MR-Egger 检验水平多效性。
tools.notesEn: IVW is the primary method. MR-Egger tests for horizontal pleiotropy.

steps.notes: IVW 为主方法。MR-Egger 检验水平多效性。
steps.notesEn: IVW is the primary method. MR-Egger tests for horizontal pleiotropy.

steps.name: 敏感性分析
steps.description: Cochran's Q 异质性、MR-Egger 截距多效性、Leave-one-out、MR-PRESSO 离群值、Steiger 因果方向
steps.descriptionEn: Cochran's Q heterogeneity, MR-Egger intercept pleiotropy, leave-one-out, MR-PRESSO outliers, Steiger directionality

tools.name: TwoSampleMR mr_heterogeneity()
tools.notes: Cochran's Q P < 0.05 表示异质性。

tools.name: TwoSampleMR mr_pleiotropy_test()
tools.notes: MR-Egger 截距 P < 0.05 表示水平多效性。
tools.notesEn: MR-Egger intercept P < 0.05 indicates horizontal pleiotropy.

tools.name: MR-PRESSO
tools.notes: 离群值检测 + 失真检验。

tools.name: TwoSampleMR mr_leaveoneout()
tools.notes: 逐个 SNP 剔除，检查是否有单一 SNP 驱动结果。
tools.notesEn: Leave-one-out analysis to check if a single SNP drives the result.

steps.notes: Cochran's Q P < 0.05 表示异质性。 MR-Egger 截距 P < 0.05 表示水平多效性。 离群值检测 + 失真检验。 逐个 SNP 剔除，检查是否有单一 SNP 驱动结果。
steps.notesEn: Cochran's Q P < 0.05 indicates heterogeneity. MR-Egger intercept P < 0.05 indicates horizontal pleiotropy. Outlier detection + distortion test. Leave-one-out analysis to check if a single SNP drives the result.

steps.name: 多变量 MR (可选)
steps.description: 控制混杂暴露，评估独立因果效应
steps.descriptionEn: Control for confounding exposures, assess independent causal effects

tools.name: TwoSampleMR mv_multivariable_mr()
tools.notes: 多变量 MR 控制混杂暴露。
tools.notesEn: Multivariable MR controls for confounding exposures.

steps.notes: 多变量 MR 控制混杂暴露。
steps.notesEn: Multivariable MR controls for confounding exposures.
